nodes.title: master_concept
widgets_values: A mysterious silver-haired swordswoman stands in a rain-darkened shrine courtyard. She wears a layered black and crimson ceremonial coat with engraved metal guards, braided cords, and weathered leather details. Her expression is calm and determined. Lantern light reflects on wet stone, drifting mist and red maple leaves. Full body portrait, readable silhouette, cinematic anime illustration.

nodes.title: anima_style_anchor
widgets_values: masterpiece, best quality, anime illustration, cinematic lighting, clean linework, detailed materials, consistent character design

nodes.title: motion_instruction
widgets_values: One continuous five-second shot. The character slowly walks forward toward the camera with measured, confident steps, keeping the sword in a calm ready position. Her shoulders turn slightly with the movement before she settles into a composed guard pose. Hair, coat hems, mist, and loose leaves follow with restrained natural inertia. Locked medium-full portrait camera, no cuts, stable identity, natural walking motion, and a settled final pose.
